Simsala Grimm | Simsala Grimm (1999–2010) is a German-Austrian television series, consisting of stories based on fairy tales by Grimm Brothers, Hans Christian Andersen and other notable authors.

A girl (Sorcha) must sew six shirts from a painful nettle plant in order to save her brothers from a witch's enchantment, remaining completely mute until the task is finished.  Falling in love complicates her mission.
Love's Brother | Love's Brother is a 2004 film written and directed by Jan Sardi.  The film is based on the same story as the Pre-Code movie A Lady to Love (1930).
